messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends in Canada for 2023. Each entry shows the holiday, the day it falls on, and the full weekend that becomes a “long weekend” (including the holiday and the adjacent weekend days).

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included |
|---------|-------------|------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, January 1 | Saturday 30 – Monday 2 (Jan 30–Feb 2, 2022‑2023) |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, NB, PEI)* | Monday, February 20 | Saturday 18 – Monday 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, April 7 | Friday 7 – Sunday 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Saturday 20 – Monday 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, July 1 | Saturday 1 – Monday 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, September 4 | Saturday 2 – Monday 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, October 9 | Saturday 7 – Monday 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday, November 11 | Saturday 11 – Monday 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, December 25 | Saturday 23 – Monday 25 |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, December 26 | Saturday 24 – Monday 26 |

> **Note:**  
> - Some holidays (e.g., Family Day) are only observed in specific provinces.  
> - When a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is usually the following Monday, creating a longer weekend.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need provincial variations or more details, let me know.
